controls.lesson: A true level-match return needs a 30-second breathing window; +100% protection may arm after that, while an exceptional +150% move may protect immediately.
Do not brief an opposite Heist return during a young same-side BUILDING/SPROUT arc with TP ownership and no current weakness.
An ultra-cheap seed at an extended parent top remains eligible even before visible weakness; promotion must survive beyond a blind 180-second timeout while the return arc is physically current.
Preserve the confirmed Release acquisition and immediate exceptional-profit protection.
Do not send a 40-cent opposite briefing against a mature extended DOWN parent with NO TP ownership and no current weakness.
The bottom entry was valid and reached +110%; protect it after the breathing window, but exit after support genuinely fails rather than holding indefinitely.
A directly observed UP BUILDING arc with YES TP ownership is positive continuation evidence even before the EMA gap fully flips; do not send the NO renter briefing.
A mature stalled level-match seed should remain in transition custody while TP favors the NO bounce or the outgoing parent is turning.
Inside the last five minutes, a confirmed Release that reaches +60% after 30 seconds earns a 5% peak trail; exceptional +150% may protect immediately.
